name: MOGTAU
rules_text:
Draw a card.
If you would lose the game while this card is in your hand, instead you may remove it from the game and set your life to 1. If you do, pause the current player's turn, and take an extra turn immediately. After the extra turn, return play to the paused turn.
flavor_text: Even Mog can’t race the checker twice.

name: Mog Cardboard Cutout
rules_text:
+2 {H}
Remove a card in the center row from the game. Replace it with a card from the center deck.
flavor_text: I’m pretty sure Mog would approve. -Mog

name: Mog Crumpton
rules_text:
+2 {H}
Technology cards cost 1 less this turn.
flavor_text: I’ll buy the set with no hesitation if it includes “Rookie Numbers,” Mog style. -Mog Crumpton

name: Mog Filler
rules_text: When this comes into play, draw a card.
flavor_text: Drawing cards is hard, but it’s good filler. -Mog

name: Mog Fun Police
rules_text:
+2 {H}
Each player (including you) discards a permanent which costs 4 or less.
flavor_text: Any chance of keeping it down over there? The talk just got mogrolled. -Mog

name: Mog Pooping in the Dark
rules_text: Discard your hand, then draw that many cards.
flavor_text: Even Mog needs a quiet plot.

name: Mog Should Have Preregistered
rules_text:
Remove any number of cards in your hand from the game.
Deal 1 {D} for each card removed this way.
flavor_text: Mog: I should have preregistered, too.

name: Mog Wonka
rules_text: Search your deck and discard pile for five cards. The player to your left separates them into two piles. Choose a pile. Put the chosen pile into your hand. Remove the other pile from the game.

name: MogAlphaWolf
rules_text:
+2 {H}
You may remove this card from the game. If you do, draw a card.
flavor_text: Wow! Mog just covered "The Reason" song from PhreakNIC! -MogAlphaWolf

name: MogMyst
flavor_text: When you die in the Clarion, Mog dies in real life. -_NSAKEY

name: Mogdy
rules_text:
+2 {H}
Location cards cost 1 less this turn.
flavor_text: How did you come back with this many rolls, Mog?

name: Mogmart Parking Lot
rules_text:
This comes into play with 4 ICE counters.
When you would take damage, remove that many counters from this instead.
If you have played a card named "heartsh8ped" this turn, you may buy this card for free.
flavor_text: The challenge wasn’t to visit a Mogmart parking lot. -Mog

name: Mognaul
rules_text:
+2 {H}
When you buy this card, each player gains 5 life.
flavor_text: After I had your secrets, I felt compelled to share.

name: Mognet
rules_text: Once per turn, gain +1 {H} for each card named "Mognet" you control.
flavor_text: One scoop. Many nodes. All Mog.

name: Mog’s AI Camry
rules_text: As often as you like on your turn, you may pay 2 {H} to make each other player discard a card.
flavor_text: New phenomenon yesterday... the first time my AI Camry drove me home (That I know about). -Mog

name: Mog's CTF Bangers
rules_text:
Draw a card.
Whenever a permanent you control would deal damage, it deals 1 extra damage.
flavor_text: That banger is so Moggy. -Mog Rogers

name: Mog’s Candy Factory
rules_text:
This comes into play with 4 ICE counters.
When you would take damage, remove that many counters from this instead.
When you remove the last counter, discard this card.
As often as you like on your turn, you may discard a hero card to add 1 ICE counter to this.
flavor_text: After Mog saw the gumball throughput, he felt compelled to stay.

name: Mog’s Clarion Inn Chandeliers
rules_text: You may remove this card from the game to put a different card that has been removed from the game into your hand.
flavor_text: Neat. -Mog

name: Mog's Clarion Inn Closet
rules_text:
This comes into play with 2 ICE counter.
When you would take damage, remove that many counters from this instead.
When you remove the last counter, discard this card.
At the start of your turn, add 2 ICE counters to this.
flavor_text: It’s still a strange hotel, but now it’s Mog’s Clarion Inn Chandeliers. -Mog

name: Mog’s Desk
rules_text: At the beginning of your turn, choose a permanent in play. Gain control of it.
flavor_text: After a day at Def con, I really shouldn’t. -Mog

name: Mog's Disassembled Sink
rules_text: Once per turn, you may remove a card in your hand from the game. If you do, draw a card.
flavor_text: Mog says a real sink is just an API with leaks.

name: Mog’s Etch-a-Sketch Skillz
rules_text: Copy the effect of an action card in another player's discard pile.
flavor_text: Mog once etched “Be excellent” at a conference.

name: Mog's Lemon Custard Ice Cream
rules_text:
Deal 1 {D}
If you've played a card called "Rookie Numbers" this turn, draw 3 cards.
flavor_text: After I had your ice cream, I felt compelled to stay

name: Mog’s Lowes Shopping Cart
rules_text:
As often as you like on your turn, you may pay {H} to put a counter on this.
When this has 25 or more counters on it, you win the game.
flavor_text: Mog loads it up, eventually. -crankbait

name: Mog’s Makeshift Lectern
rules_text: On your turn, hero cards cost 1 less.
flavor_text: When Mog doesn’t know what to do, he does nothing. -Mog

name: Mog's OSINT for Dummies
rules_text:
+1 {H}
Draw two cards.
flavor_text: Good OSINT is supposed to make you feel something. -Mog

name: Mog's Pancake Breakfast
rules_text:
+1 {H}
You may pay up to 3 {H} to gain that much life.
flavor_text: Did they bring back the breakfast bar!? -Brimstone

name: Mog’s PhreakNIC
rules_text:
+1 {H}
Deal 1 {D}. Gain 1 life.
Draw a card.
Legendary cards cost 2 less this turn.
flavor_text: We’re all Mog’s children.

name: Mog's Speakers Needed
rules_text: Shuffle your discard pile into your deck. Reveal cards from the top of your deck until you reveal a hero card. Put that card into your hand. Discard the rest.
flavor_text: I actually need you to prep this year! -Mog

name: Mog’s White Python Boots
rules_text: As often as you like on your turn, you may pay 2 {H} to draw a card.
flavor_text: These boots go hard, actually. -Mog

name: MogsterL
rules_text:
+2 {H}
When you buy this card, you may put a card from your discard pile on top of your deck.
flavor_text: Mog says: sometimes the best infiltration is just buying another card.

name: MogsyBacchus
rules_text:
+2 {H}
Discard any number of cards from your hand. Draw that many cards.
flavor_text: LOL, Mog please don’t ban me. -MogsyBacchus

name: Mogvious
rules_text:
+2 {H}
When you buy this card, you may choose and discard a permanent card in play.
flavor_text: I would like a Mognet scope decision on what fun means. -Mog

name: Mogwarez
rules_text:
+2 {H}
Discard any number of cards from your hand. Gain 1 {H} for each card discarded this way.
flavor_text: DRINK! -Mog

name: Payphone Karaoke
rules_text:
Choose Two:
Gain 1 life,
Draw a card,
+1 {H}
flavor_text: I’m trying to decompile a binary and I’m being pulled away to sing a Disney song. -Zenthere

name: Rookie Numbers
rules_text:
Deal 2 {D}.
Draw a card.
If any player's discard pile contains a card with "Mog" in the name, that player loses 2 life.
flavor_text: Thats it, you’re grounded for three weeks!

name: Still not Mog
rules_text:
+2 {H}
You may remove this from the game. If you do, choose and discard a permanent in play.
flavor_text: "How do you like dem pTFS?"

name: Tennessee Department of Mog
rules_text: As often as you like on your turn, you may remove a counter from any location.
flavor_text: For additional information, check Mog’s talks at ______________

name: The Big Mogger
rules_text: Once per turn, gain 1 life.
flavor_text: Eat foods that make you Mog. -Oprah

name: The Mog
rules_text:
At the start of your turn, attach an action from your hand to this, then play every attached action.
If this leaves play, put all attached actions into your discard pile.
flavor_text: It’s just Mog... but louder.

file: assets/cards/mog/Tips and tricks for Windows and Mog.jpg
name: Tips and tricks for Windows and Mog
rules_text:
+2 {H}
You may reserve a card this turn even if you buy a card.
flavor_text: It works in a Mogpinch. -benthemeek
original_id: Tips and tricks for Windows OS and Office365

name: Touch Mog
rules_text:
Players may not buy cards.
At the end of your next turn, remove this card from the game.
flavor_text: My brother, have you ever touched grass? -Mog

name: Treasure Moggers
rules_text:
+1 {H}
Pay any amount of {H}, then reveal cards from the top of the center deck until you reveal a card which costs that amount. Acquire that card. Shuffle the center deck.
flavor_text: Mog’s treasure radar is absurdly on point.

name: Under New Mogagement
rules_text:
Deal 2 {D}
You may take a card with "Clarion" in its name from any discard pile and place it into your discard pile.
flavor_text: You don’t need good internet, Mognet’s fine. -_NSAKEY

name: Where's Mog?!
rules_text: Draw 3 cards, then discard 2 cards.
flavor_text: In a Mognet! -Random audience member

name: Who is Mog?
rules_text:
+1 {H}
This card is considered to have all card names.
flavor_text: <weird mogging sound> -Mog

name: [Mog’s Restaurant Name] Restaurant
rules_text:
When this comes into play, if there is another location in play, you may have this come into play as a copy of that location. If you do, ignore the text below.
This comes into play with 3 ICE counters.
When you would take damage, remove that many counters from this instead.
When you remove the last counter, discard this card.
flavor_text: A restaurant so good, I felt compelled to stay.

name: pTFMOG
rules_text:
When you buy a hero, you may place it on this card instead of in your discard pile. If this leaves play, put any cards on this card into your discard pile.
At the start of your turn, put all heros on this into your hand.
You may buy pTFS Heros for free.
flavor_text: Previously Topped Mognet Standings
